hero.title: Tone & Style
hero.description: Shape how every reply sounds. The live preview updates as you adjust the settings.

preview.customerMessage: My order still has not arrived. Can you check the status?

assistantTemplates.friendly: I’m sorry for the delay. I’m checking the order status now and will keep this simple and clear.
assistantTemplates.warm_expert: I’m sorry the order has taken longer than expected. I’m checking the shipment details now and will share the next step as soon as I have it.
assistantTemplates.professional: Thank you for reaching out. I’m checking the shipment status and will confirm the next step shortly.
assistantTemplates.playful: I’m on it. Let me check the order status and get you a clear update.
assistantTemplates.luxury: Thank you for your patience. I’m reviewing the shipment details now and will follow up with a precise update.
assistantTemplates.custom: I’m checking the order status now and will respond with the next step as soon as I have it.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Build every dimension to match your brand.

warmth.high: High warmth leads with empathy before the logistics.
warmth.medium: Balanced warmth keeps the reply helpful without sounding distant.
warmth.low: Lower warmth keeps the tone brisk and to the point.

formality.high: Higher formality uses a more polished register.
formality.medium: Medium formality stays professional without feeling stiff.
formality.low: Lower formality sounds more relaxed and conversational.

energy.high: Higher energy gives the reply more lift and momentum.
energy.medium: Medium energy keeps the message steady and composed.
energy.low: Lower energy keeps the response calm and measured.

playfulness.high: Higher playfulness adds lightness where it fits.
playfulness.medium: Medium playfulness adds a subtle human touch.
playfulness.low: Lower playfulness keeps the reply straightforward.

directness.high: Higher directness gets to the answer quickly.
directness.medium: Medium directness balances clarity and context.
directness.low: Lower directness leaves more room for softening language.

answer_length.concise: Concise answers stay short and focused.
answer_length.standard: Standard answers give enough detail without drifting.
answer_length.thorough: Thorough answers leave more room for explanation.

frequency_policy.none: No repeated phrases keeps the response varied.
frequency_policy.sparing: Sparing repetition keeps the voice natural.
frequency_policy.moderate: Moderate repetition can reinforce brand language.
frequency_policy.liberal: Higher repetition makes signature phrasing more noticeable.
frequency_policy.free: Free repetition keeps the language unconstrained.

regional_spelling.auto: Spelling follows the store's detected audience.

use_bullet_points.true: Bullet points help organize longer answers.
use_bullet_points.false: Paragraphs keep the reply more fluid.
